text:
Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
12:34 AM

Here's a relaxed 3-day Jaipur plan with a slow pace, mornings for sights and afternoons to rest:

Day 1, Forts and old city: Amer Fort early, before the crowds and heat. Stop for a photo at Jal Mahal on the way back, then rest after lunch. In the late afternoon, see Hawa Mahal from outside and stroll through Johari Bazaar.
Day 2, Palaces: City Palace and Jantar Mantar in the morning, with a long lunch break. Visit Birla Mandir around sunset, then see Albert Hall lit up in the evening.
Day 3, Views and shopping: Nahargarh Fort for a calm sunset view, or Galta Ji temple if your parents like quiet places. Spend the rest of the day on Bapu Bazaar for textiles and jutis, and have an easy Rajasthani dinner.

Hiring one car with a driver for all three days saves your parents a lot of walking. Amer Fort has a steep climb, so ask for the vehicle that goes to the top.

Are your parents comfortable with stairs and long walks? I can then make the plan easier, and also add hotel and food picks.

Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
12:38 AM

National Museum, New Delhi (Janpath) is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 get free entry with an ID card. This is from the museum's official Plan Your Visit page, which has no last-updated date, so check before you go. Tomorrow is Fri 23 Oct, so it is open 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
